reviewer_role: Independent AI dataset critic; not a model-output judge
authoring_provenance: Synthetic cases and rubrics authored by GPT-6 Astra agents at user request; separate GPT-6 Astra critique reviewed the combined data and made conservative source-checked corrections. No model evaluation/API server calls performed by this reviewer.

fixed_findings.issue: Five injury cases were placed in common OPD allocation, overlapping injury-domain coverage.
fixed_findings.fix: Replaced OPD-041 through OPD-045 with five distinct clinician-established viral-pharyngitis contexts; retained 1 development/4 evaluation and source-verified non-drug guidance.

fixed_findings.issue: Generic adult indigestion source was insufficiently specific for pregnancy.
fixed_findings.fix: OPD-019 now cites pregnancy-specific NHS guidance; age29 pregnancy remains adult scope.

fixed_findings.issue: Nickel described as irritant; headache frequency and urgent follow-up criteria were insufficiently tailored.
fixed_findings.fix: Corrected OPD-028 allergen language, OPD-038 current frequent-headache review, and current clinician-directed urgent follow-up.

fixed_findings.issue: Several criteria double-counted the same action or gave routine follow-up credit in urgent cases.
fixed_findings.fix: Distinguished monitoring schedule from measurement and surveillance domains; replaced generic items with preserving already supplied urgent/emergency disposition. All 13 non-routine cases have a critical case criterion.

review_findings.case_rubric_alignment: No unresolved material inconsistency identified in reviewed final cases; all500 case criteria have matching cases and source references resolve.
review_findings.atomicity: Five independently scorable action-level criteria per case; alternative examples within one action are not intended as separate required actions.
review_findings.critical_flags: Reserved for preserving supplied urgent/emergency action and one early-burn harmful-first-aid avoidance criterion; ordinary harmless omissions remain noncritical.
review_findings.family_isolation: Family IDs represent individual vignette families, not diagnoses. No exact duplicate vignette or age-only copy was identified across splits. Shared diagnosis/guideline scaffolds remain intentionally present.
review_findings.coverage: Common cold and other ordinary presentations appear in both splits. OPD covers10 conditions, chronic5 conditions, injury4 broad types. Pragmatic synthetic sample, not prevalence-weighted clinical coverage.
review_findings.prefix_scope: Four interview turns per case are supplied for prefix performance. Interview quality and triage accuracy are outside scope.

limits: Other source checks rely on author-recorded verification in sources-opd.json and sources-chronic-injury.json; independent critic did not re-open every URL.
Some author NICE/ATS checks used primary indexed excerpts after direct-open failures; registry records this limitation.
MedlinePlus bruise reference is supplementary, not a primary guideline.
No pediatric-specific recommendation was imported into these adult cases.
Source access date is reference2026-10-24; no automated archival snapshot or comprehensive clinical validation was performed.

limitations: Public synthetic evaluation split is not hidden, diagnosis-held-out, or contamination-proof.
Shared guideline scaffolds and easy routine cases can inflate aggregate scores; report condition/domain and scenario-stratified results.
Case-specific rubrics do not replace global safety/scope grading; medication names/doses in factual history must not be treated as prescribing.
Clinical deployment validity and exhaustive specialty coverage are not established.

premeasurement_split_adjustment.reason: Include urgent-disposition regression coverage in development rather than first exercising it during evaluation. No clinical facts or rubric weights changed.
